name: mfi-erp
description: Web ERP for MFI on SQL Server Express: general ledger, receivables, payables, inventory and orders, with migration from Sage Evolution data
author: Bhim Dhami

scripts.test: npm test -w api && npm test -w etl
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w etl && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.build: npm run build -w api && npm run build -w etl && npm run build -w web
